interpretation: Two independent durable ActionRef allocators in one SQLite database both issue 1 for the same synthetic account. This is a structural single-authority blocker, not evidence that a provider received or observed a duplicate.

table_schemas.ctp_action_identity_reservations:
CREATE TABLE ctp_action_identity_reservations (
                        account_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        trading_day TEXT NOT NULL,
                        scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                        managed_action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        managed_intent_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        runtime_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                        order_ref TEXT NOT NULL
                            CHECK(length(order_ref) = 12 AND order_ref NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'),
                        native_action_ref INTEGER NOT NULL
                            CHECK(native_action_ref BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
                        created_at_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
                        PRIMARY KEY(account_key, scope_key, managed_action_id),
                        UNIQUE(account_key, native_action_ref),
                        FOREIGN KEY(account_key, scope_key, managed_intent_id)
                            REFERENCES ctp_order_identity_reservations(
                                account_key, scope_key, managed_intent_id
                            )
                    )
table_schemas.ctp_native_action_ref_allocations:
CREATE TABLE ctp_native_action_ref_allocations (
                    account_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                    native_action_ref INTEGER NOT NULL
                        CHECK(typeof(native_action_ref) = 'integer' AND
                              native_action_ref BETWEEN 1 AND 2147483647),
                    scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
                    command_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    managed_action_id TEXT NOT NULL,
                    allocated_at_ns INTEGER NOT NULL,
                    PRIMARY KEY(account_key, native_action_ref),
                    UNIQUE(account_key, command_id),
                    UNIQUE(account_key, scope_key, managed_action_id),
                    FOREIGN KEY(account_key, command_id)
                        REFERENCES ctp_dispatch_commands(account_key, command_id)
                )
table_schemas.ctp_native_action_ref_counters:
CREATE TABLE ctp_native_action_ref_counters (
                    account_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    last_action_ref INTEGER NOT NULL
                        CHECK(typeof(last_action_ref) = 'integer' AND
                              last_action_ref BETWEEN 0 AND 2147483647),
                    updated_at_ns INTEGER NOT NULL
                )

v21_allocation_scope: The Store allocator primitive was called in its own committed SQLite transaction; full cancel command staging and the command-to-ActionRef mapping insert were not called.
